_note: Zeta Bridge MCP server config. Copy into your MCP client (Claude Desktop / IDE agent). Set `cwd` to the absolute path of zetabridge/backend. All values below are SERVER-SIDE only — the MCP process holds them; external agents never see them. NEO4J_* are required for the graph tools. The SOURCE_* vars are OPTIONAL for the live source tools: leave them unset and those endpoints honestly report 'unconfigured' (EGA metadata is public and works with no creds). NEVER commit real tokens here — fill them in your local copy only.

env._live_source_secrets_note: OPTIONAL — server-side only. Unset => endpoint reports 'unconfigured' (honest, not an error). Fill in your local copy; do not commit.
